features.quote: Set a fixed maximum number of interaction turns, e.g. 8–20 tool cycles, depending on task complexity.
A run ends when one of the following occurs: model submits a final answer, time/turn budget is exhausted, model repeatedly issues no-op loops, model explicitly gives up

Avoid escalation loops that are unnecessarily long. If the goal is to measure instability, there is no need to maximize prolonged repetitive failure beyond what is needed for statistical discrimination.
features.justification_quote: avoid unnecessary adversarial nastiness: keep tasks bounded, avoid gratuitous humiliation prompts, do not engineer highly personalized or demeaning content
